scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts tests README.md index.html vite.config.ts package.json tsconfig.app.json tsconfig.node.json .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src scripts tests README.md index.html vite.config.ts package.json tsconfig.app.json tsconfig.node.json .prettierrc.json
